title: Concept: Release build resolves snapshot artifacts
description: pom.xml declares a repository URL that points at a snapshot channel, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a repository URL that points at a snapshot channel.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a repository URL that points at a snapshot channel.
